To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Neural Networks can be designed to store and reuse learnt Neural Programs, (2) The stored Neural Programs can be treated as data, and (3) The stored Neural Program can be reused and composed to solve more complex tasks.
we design a new class of neural networks that can learn general-purpose computation using stored neural programs.

“We design Neurocoder, the first general-purpose neural network architecture in which the neural programs are stored in external memory and can be reused and composed, and we show how Neurocoder can solve complex tasks by reusing simple programs and remembering old programs as new programs are learnt, which is a new capacity of Neural Programs that has not been demonstrated before.”
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new class of neural network that can learn to store and execute programs in a data-responsive manner.
the question of how to learn a new skill in a neural network.
the design of general-purpose neural network architectures, and the development of novel algorithms for learning, storing and retrieving neural programs in memory.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Neurocoder is a new class of neural networks that can learn general purpose programs from data.
Neurocoder is a new class of artificial neural networks that learns and executes general purpose programs, and can be integrated into current neural networks to solve new problems.
Neurocoder, the new class of general purpose neural networks, is able to store neural programs in external memory.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose to store the Neural Programs learnt by neural networks in external memory, and use them to compose more complex programs, which is the first time a Neural Program is treated as a datum, thus allowing the network to learn general-purpose computation.
Neurocoder enables a new class of neural network that learns general-purpose neural programs in memory, which is a key step towards building general-purpose AI.

Neurocoder is the first general-purpose neural network that learns and stores Neural Programs, enabling new capabilities to learn and use modular programs, handle pattern shifts, remember old programs and reuse programs to build complex tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a Neural Program can be efficiently treated as a data item in memory, and that a neural network can learn to compose programs from a set to build new ones.
the Neural Program is not a static, immutable entity, but can be stored, retrieved, and recombined to build complex programs.
the neural network can be viewed as a general-purpose computer that learns to compute the data using its own programs stored in external memories.
